The Booking.com Demand API is a RESTful API that enables Affiliate Partners to access Booking.com's extensive travel inventory. It provides endpoints for searching accommodations such as hotels and apartments, checking availability, retrieving reviews, and getting detailed property information. The API uses JSON responses and requires HTTPS POST requests with Affiliate ID and Bearer token authentication. The latest version (V3.1) offers improved functionality and additional endpoints for building travel booking experiences including orders management, messaging, and payment information.
